title: Layered polynomial size implies polynomial size
statement: If a language over Boolean strings is recognized by a family of finite layered Boolean circuits using only the standard gate operations, with size bounded by a function $T$, and there are natural numbers $a,k$ such that $T(n)\leq a(n+1)^k$ for every natural number $n$, then the language has polynomial size in the sense that it is recognized by a family of Boolean circuits with at most two inputs per gate and size at most $a'(n+1)^{k'}$ for some natural numbers $a',k'$ at every input length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over Boolean strings
$L$ is recognized by a finite layered-circuit family using only the standard gate operations and of size at most $T(n)$ at each input length $n$
